<think>
Hausa ne amma dole ne in fahimci cewa tambayar ta ƙarshe tana cikin Hausa, amma bayanan da aka bayar na misalan suna cikin Hausa kuma suna da amsoshi. Tambayar ta ƙarshe tana game da gwajin da za a yi don fahimtar janyewar ruwa (plasmolysis).

Plasmolysis shine lokacin da kwayar halitta ta rasa ruwa ta hanyar osmosis, wanda ke haifar da raguwar tantanin halitta daga bangon tantanin halitta. Wannan yana faruwa ne lokacin da tantanin halitta ya kasance cikin mafitar ruwa (hypertonic solution), inda ruwa ya fita daga cikin tantanin halitta.

Yanzu, ina kallon zaɓuɓɓukan gwaje-gwaje:

A. A jika dankali guda, da aka riga aka daka a cikin ruwan gishiri, na tsawon sa'o'i biyu, sannan a sake daka shi.

B. A jiƙa ɗan naman da aka riga aka daka a ruwan gishiri na tsawon awa biyu, sannan kuma a sake dakashi

C. Jikà karas da aka riga aka latsa a cikin ruwan da aka tace na tsawon kwana biyu, kuma a sake latsashi bayan an cire shi daga ruwan

D. A jika kwai wanda aka cire bawon sa a cikin ruwa mai tsafta, sannan a lura da canjin girma bayan kwanaki uku

Ina bukatar in gane wanne daga cikin waɗannan gwaje-gwajen zai nuna plasmolysis.

Plasmolysis yana faruwa a cikin tantanin halittar shuka, musamman a cikin tantanin halittar parenchyma, kamar a cikin dankali ko karas. Kwai ba shi da tantanin halittar shuka; yana da tantanin halittar dabba, wanda ba ya fuskantar plasmolysis kamar na shuka. A cikin tantanin halittar dabba, suna da bangon tantanin halitta mara ƙarfi, don haka suna fuskantar lysis (ƙarfafa) a cikin ruwa maras gishiri (hypotonic) ko crenation (shrinkage) a cikin ruwan gishiri (hypertonic), amma ba plasmolysis ba.

Don haka, zaɓin D na kwai ba shi da alaƙa da plasmolysis, saboda ba tantanin halittar shuka bane.

Yanzu, zaɓuɓɓukan A, B, da C sun haɗa da abubuwan shuka.

A: Dankali (potato) - wani abu na shuka.

B: "ɗan naman" - wannan zai iya nufin nama, amma a cikin Hausa, "ɗan naman" na iya nufin ɗan ƙaramin nama, amma a nan, tunda yana da alaƙa da gwajin kimiyya, yana iya zama misali na shuka. Amma kalmar "ɗan naman" tana nufin "a piece of meat" a Turanci, wanda shine nama na dabba. Idan haka ne, to, ba shi da tantanin halittar shuka. Amma a wasu lokuta, ana iya amfani da shi don nufin wani abu mai laushi. Ina bukata in tabbata.

A cikin misalin, "ɗan naman" yana iya zama kuskure. Amma a cikin gwajin kimiyya, yawanci ana amfani da dankali ko karas don gwada osmosis.

C: Karas (cucumber) - shuka ne.

D: Kwai - ba shuka bane.

B: "ɗan naman" - idan yana nufin nama na dabba, to, ba zai nuna plasmolysis ba. Plasmolysis na musamman ne ga tantanin halittar shuka saboda suna da bangon tantanin halitta mai ƙarfi.

Don haka, zaɓin B zai iya zama mara dacewa idan "ɗan naman" shine nama na dabba.

Yanzu, ga gwajin kanta.

Plasmolysis yana buƙatar:

- Tantinin shuka mai rai.

- Sanya shi cikin mafitar ruwa (hypertonic solution), kamar ruwan gishiri.

- Sannan a lura da raguwar tantinin halitta daga bangon tantanin halitta.

A cikin zaɓin A: Ana jika dankali da aka riga aka daka (crushed) a cikin ruwan gishiri. Amma idan an daka shi, to, tantanin halitta sun lalace, don haka ba za a iya lura da plasmolysis ba. Plasmolysis yana buƙatar tantinin halitta ya kasance mai rai kuma gabaɗaya don lura da canji.

A cikin zaɓin B: "ɗan naman" - idan shine nama na dabba, ba zai aiki ba. Ko da yana nufin wani abu, amma kalmar "dakashi" tana nufin crushing, wanda zai lalata tantanin halitta.

A cikin zaɓin C: Karas da aka riga aka latsa (pressed) a cikin ruwan da aka tace (filtered water). Ruwan da aka tace yana iya zama ruwa mai tsafta, wanda hypotonic ne, ba hypertonic ba. Don plasmolysis, ana buƙatar hypertonic solution. Ruwan da aka tace ba shi da gishiri, don haka zai sa ruwa ya shiga cikin tantanin halitta, yana haifar da turgor, ba plasmolysis ba. Sannan ana sake latsashi bayan an cire shi daga ruwan, amma ruwan ba hypertonic bane.

Zaɓin C ya ce "ruwan da aka tace" wanda zai iya zama distilled water ko filtered water, wanda yawanci hypotonic ne. Ba shi da gishiri, don haka ba zai haifar da plasmolysis ba.
